decision.selection_reason: Phase 1 proves that the qualified parent state can select existing governing brief, canon manifest, story bible, book plan and manuscript objects but cannot create/register/version new instances. The same missing parent admission seam also explains the chapter/scene persistence gap. A second chapter/scene engine would duplicate canonical version/admission authority, so both are bounded into one parent-owned content-object admission successor.
decision.book_intelligence_decision: NO_SEPARATE_CANONICAL_WRITE_ORCHESTRATOR. Book Intelligence remains the macro/meso/micro planning, analysis and proposal-orchestration architecture already bound by BOOK-SYSTEM-BOOK-INTELLIGENCE-UNIFICATION-BINDING-001. It may produce bounded plans, evidence and proposals, but canonical materialization/version/admission remains solely in the selected Book parent content-admission seam.
decision.chapter_scene_decision: INCLUDE_IN_SAME_ADMISSION_ENGINE. CHAPTER and SCENE are Book domain units with persistent identity, ordered parent relationships and immutable versions, but do not receive an independent canonical-write authority or lifecycle engine.
decision.document_boundary: Document rendering, conversion, layout, accessibility validation and rendered proof remain Document System/provider responsibilities. The selected successor stores exact artifact/provenance references only; it does not implement a renderer.
decision.prose_boundary: PROSE and Book Evaluator remain child/provider evidence and proposal sources. Neither can directly register or activate canonical Book content.
decision.human_publication_boundary: Real author decisions and publication authorization remain human/external authority. Machine admission may record and enforce a valid decision receipt but may not synthesize one.

proposed_contract.aggregate_extension_rule: Extend the existing canonical Book aggregate rather than create a second store or state authority.
transaction_preconditions: expected_state_version and expected_state_digest must match the current aggregate before any operation
new object/version IDs are immutable and collision-free
content_digest_sha256 binds exact bytes or an exact governed artifact reference
parent_version_ref resolves to an existing predecessor when a predecessor is required
CHAPTER and SCENE parent references resolve inside the same Book project and their ordering is deterministic
proposal/evidence source identities are current and provenance-bound before admission
any required author decision receipt is explicit, current and subject-bound
all operations are atomic; one failed precondition aborts the full mutation
authority_rules: Only PARENT_SYSTEM may commit canonical registration/activation operations.
PROSE_PROJECT, BOOK_EVALUATOR, RESEARCH_IMPORT and external providers may supply proposals/evidence but cannot commit canonical content.
Lifecycle v1 remains the sole project lifecycle transition authority; this successor cannot advance lifecycle status.
Version/Rollback remains the immutable history and RESTORE_AS_NEW_SUCCESSOR authority; this successor must append compatible version evidence and cannot mutate history.
Export Freeze remains a separate gate and cannot be inferred from content admission.
Technical success never implies publication authorization.
idempotency_and_concurrency: same mutation_id plus byte-identical payload returns the same committed result or a deterministic already-applied result
same mutation_id with different payload fails closed
stale expected_state_version or expected_state_digest fails without partial mutation
duplicate object_id/version_id with non-identical digest fails closed
concurrent chapter/scene reorder against the same predecessor allows at most one successor and forces the loser to rebase

minimum_fixture_classes: register each supported content class with exact digest and provenance
create a second immutable version linked to its exact predecessor
reject duplicate object/version identity with divergent bytes
reject missing required author decision receipt without fabricating it
preserve lifecycle status while content is admitted
preserve Version/Rollback history and allow later restore-as-new-successor semantics
register chapter and scene units under valid parents
reject duplicate ordinals or ambiguous ordering under one parent unless contractually resolved
reject scene/chapter relationship cycles where a hierarchy edge is required to be acyclic
prove failed multi-operation mutation is atomic
prove idempotent replay and divergent-replay rejection
prove export/publication state is not granted by content admission
required_evidence: deterministic fixture manifest and result counts
state digest before/after every accepted mutation
hosted qualification on the exact final wrapper-bearing SHA before any A-01 admission
separate authoritative A-01 receipt only if/when the registered qualification is later admitted

shared_governance_deltas_for_later_recon.finding: BOOK-SYSTEM-VERSION-AND-ROLLBACK-001 is still marked ACTIVE although authoritative Book evidence records its exact-subject A-01 closure.
shared_governance_deltas_for_later_recon.action: P8/global reconciliation must close/supersede the stale registry entry without reopening Version/Rollback implementation.

completion_delta: Before: the Phase 1 matrix proved content creation/version/admission, chapter/scene persistence and Book Intelligence executable-boundary ambiguity but did not select the smallest non-duplicative machine successor. After: one Book-parent canonical content-object admission seam is selected; chapter/scene persistence is included in the same engine; Book Intelligence remains proposal/orchestration rather than a second canonical-write authority; deterministic concurrency/idempotency/failure-injection requirements are defined; and a bounded implementation successor is executable without absorbing Prose, Document, author, publication, native or production authority.
stop_condition: SATISFIED. Every Phase 1 Book-owned gap is included in the selected successor or explicitly routed to its true owner/authority boundary, and the bounded implementation can begin from this contract without reopening qualified foundations.
continuation_rule: Bind the implementation successor to the post-checkpoint live Book head. Implement only the net-new parent content registration/version/admission seam plus deterministic fixtures. Do not modify already-qualified foundations except where a versioned adapter/extension is necessary; any changed software bytes require fresh exact-SHA hosted qualification, and A-01 remains a later separate authority boundary.
